title: The Frost Touch Primer
summary: A first primer that teaches a new frost cultivator to chill a palm and a fingertip and to guard the forearm with a film of cold.

title: A Handbook of Still Breath
summary: A handbook on slowing the breath until qi sits cold and even and on using that calm cold in a strike a guard and a gentle numbing hand.

title: The Rime Keeper's Workbook
summary: A workbook of short daily drills in laying down and holding a fine layer of rime so that the student learns how cold behaves before shaping it.

title: The Cold Palm Drill-Book
summary: A drill-book of open-hand cold work that teaches the palm to numb a limb and to strike without sound.

title: A Primer of Thrown Shards
summary: A primer on snapping slivers of ice into being and throwing them with the fingers at joints and eyes and cords.

title: The Chill Reading Handbook
summary: A handbook on feeling how warmth leaves a body and a room so that a cold cultivator can tell where a person stands and how they are hurt.

title: The Hoarfrost Guard Primer
summary: A primer on growing a coat of hoarfrost on the arms and chest that turns blows and rimes the weapon that lands.

title: A Treatise on Slow Cold
summary: A short treatise on cold that works by patience and teaches how to let a chill creep through a target until it cannot move.
